m.chalisa.do1: O Pitareśvara, lord of the ancestors, give your blessing. I have bowed my head at your feet: place your hand on my head.
m.chalisa.do2: First of all we worship Gaṇeśa, then the god of the house. O Pitareśvara, be merciful and fulfil the wish of the heart.
m.chalisa.cau1: O Pitareśvara, light up the path; the dust of your feet is an ocean of liberation.
m.chalisa.cau2: Pitareśvara has done the greatest kindness: he has granted birth as a human being.
m.chalisa.cau3: Whoever holds mother and father dear in his heart as gods gains the boundless fruit of life.
m.chalisa.cau4: Victory, victory, victory to you, revered ancestors, lord. Without paying the debt to the ancestors there is no liberation.
m.chalisa.cau5: Your glory is on every side; in trouble yours alone is the support.
m.chalisa.cau6: Nārāyaṇa is the support of creation; the ancestors are a part of that same vision.
m.chalisa.cau7: The Lord's command is proclaimed, that you be worshipped first; you yourself have the door of fortune opened.
m.chalisa.cau8: At Jhunjhunū your court is adorned; there you are enthroned with all the gods.
m.chalisa.cau9: When pleased, you have granted the fruit the heart desires; when angered, you have taken away the understanding.
m.chalisa.cau10: The glory of the ancestors is unlike any other; men and women sing its virtues.
m.chalisa.cau11: You are enthroned in the three realms, and shine as the Vasus, the Rudras and the Ādityas.
m.chalisa.cau12: Lord, all wealth is yours; I am your servant, with my son and my wife.
m.chalisa.cau13: The fifty-six dishes do not please you; you are satisfied with pure water alone.
m.chalisa.cau14: Worship of you brings the highest good; great and small, all are entitled to it.
m.chalisa.cau15: You are worshipped as the sun rises; five handfuls of water please you.
m.chalisa.cau16: Flags and banners adorn the shrine; you are present in the undying flame.
m.chalisa.cau17: Your flame is centuries old; our birthplace has been blessed.
m.chalisa.cau18: Our martyrs are worshipped here; they proclaim the message of devotion to the motherland.
m.chalisa.cau19: The ancestors of all the world: that is our principle; it is not the slogan of a religion or a caste.
m.chalisa.cau20: Hindu, Muslim, Sikh and Christian, all worship the ancestors, brother.
m.chalisa.cau21: Our family tree is Hindu; it is dearer to us than life.
m.chalisa.cau22: This is the Gaṅgā of the desert land, of a place where the water offering to the ancestors is a duty.
m.chalisa.cau23: Brother, do not leave their feet; by their grace alone the Lord's refuge is gained.
m.chalisa.cau24: On the fourteenth day we hold a night vigil; on the new moon we bow down before them.
m.chalisa.cau25: All keep the jāt (the vowed pilgrimage to the family shrine) and the jaḍūlā (a child's first tonsure); all have the Nāndīmukha śrāddha performed.
m.chalisa.cau26: Blessed is that flower of the birthplace which has received the dust of the ancestors' domain.
m.chalisa.cau27: Śrī Pitarjī, benefactor of devotees, Lord, hear our plea.
m.chalisa.cau28: Whoever meditates on you night and day, there is no other devotee like him.
m.chalisa.cau29: You are the lord and helper of those who have no one; you are always the helper of the humble.
m.chalisa.cau30: All four Vedas bear witness to the Lord; you have kept the honour of your devotees.
m.chalisa.cau31: Whoever takes your name, no one else is as blessed as he.
m.chalisa.cau32: Whoever massages your feet every day, all nine siddhis roll at his feet.
m.chalisa.cau33: Your power is wholly a blessing to one who gives himself up to you.
m.chalisa.cau34: Whoever sets his mind on your feet surely gains liberation.
m.chalisa.cau35: Whoever sings your praise with a true heart surely gains the four fruits of life.
m.chalisa.cau36: You alone are our god and our family deity; you alone are the guru, dearer than life.
m.chalisa.cau37: Whoever has a true hope in his heart, he gains the fruit he desires.
m.chalisa.cau38: Not even Śeṣa with his thousand mouths can sing your glory and the greatness of your wisdom.
m.chalisa.cau39: I am utterly humble, impure and sorrowful; how shall I make my prayer to you?
m.chalisa.cau40: Now, Pitarjī, have mercy on this humble one, and grant me some devotion to you and some of your strength.
m.chalisa.do3: Give the ancestors a place at a holy site and in your own village; let flowers of faith be offered there, and every work is fulfilled.
m.chalisa.do4: Our great ancestors are enthroned at the abode of Jhunjhunū; the sight of them makes life fruitful; the whole world worships them.
m.chalisa.do5: Whoever wants a fruitful life should go to the abode of Jhunjhunū; take the dust of the ancestors' feet, and life becomes fruitful and great.
